title: Use of Equity Report Cards to Mitigate Disparities in Emergency Medical Services (EMS) Care for Injured Children
official: Use of Equity Report Cards to Mitigate Disparities in Emergency Medical Services (EMS) Care for Injured Children
summary: This trial will assess whether development and sharing of 'Equity Report Cards' focussed on the recognition and treatment of pain for injured children by Emergency Medical Services (EMS) can help decrease disparities by race and ethnicity.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children less than 18 years old
* Assessed by District of Columbia Fire and Emergency Medical Services (DC FEMS)
* Injury related chief complaint, primary or secondary impression

Exclusion Criteria:

\- None
